title: Approval Request Created Event
description: A service is waiting on the operator to approve or reject something (a human-in-the-loop gate). One event per request; its outcome is approval.approval_request.resolved with the same approval_id.

approval_id.description: The requesting service's id for this one approval (e.g. a Voxxy consent record id).

service.description: The service that is waiting on the operator, e.g. voxxy.

approval_kind.description: What is being approved, in the service's words, e.g. voice_consent.

title.description: One line for the push title, plain ASCII preferred.

summary.description: What is waiting and why, in plain words. Never personal data from a public user (no email, no name typed by a customer beyond a display label).

decide.description: How the operator decides: a command or URL.

reason.description: Why the service could not decide by itself.
